name: Legal Rep – Superior
body:
The best lawyers cost more, but like the best accountants, they won’t see just anyone, you have to prove you have at least some cash available to you first off.

Prerequisites: Legal Rep , in possession of at least 10,000 in gp, 400 gp per month retainer

Benefits: As Legal Rep except:

Costs and legal fees are reduced by half

Lawyers personal Fee is 20% or 2,000 GP whichever is higher

Normal: As Legal Rep, including retainer. The difficulty lies in getting the lawyer to take your case in the first place.

Fantastic Feats Volume I – Economy, Law & Paperwork © 2013, Ennead Games; Author: Christopher Kentlea
